citations.claim: momentum conserved at step 7 before close approach
momentum violation at step 8: momentum_x ~65.286 and momentum_y ~0.127 vs 65.06 and ~0 at step 7
body 1 participates in close pair at violating step
body 2 close to body 1 distance 1.41 triggers accuracy loss

counterfactual.change: halved dt from 0.019418 to 0.009709 to increase integration accuracy during close encounter, removes momentum violation

explanation: Close approach between bodies 1 and 2 (distance ~1.41 at step 8) causes strong acceleration that leapfrog substepping (11 substeps) fails to integrate accurately. Potential energy drops from -368 to -448 and kinetic jumps, producing net momentum drift: momentum_x jumps from 65.06 to 65.28 and momentum_y from ~0 to 0.127 at step 8, exceeding 0.115 allowed. Halving dt removes the violation, confirming timestep/force accuracy issue, not physical momentum source.
vision_note: Two large bodies in the upper part of the frame move closer together from step 5 to step 8, forming a tight pair, while a much smaller third body stays near the bottom. At step 8 the pair is at closest approach with a noticeable kick in positions, visually consistent with a strong gravitational interaction.
